reason: For update_subtask, the cited code resolves a project/task file path, calls the subtask update routine with that local tasksJsonPath, and returns data including the updated subtask and tasks path, so it returns local project task data into the MCP response. That returned subtask/task-file content and appended prompt can be attacker-controlled/untrusted. The shown code does not execute arbitrary commands/eval or otherwise establish arbitrary host code execution. It also does not send agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination such as an agent-chosen URL or public issue/repo; it appears to update local task data only.
